donor_id: Binary encoding was applied to clinical, microbiological, and molecular profiling variables as follows:

Chronic comorbidities and microbiological results: A value of 1 indicates the documented presence of the specified comorbidity (e.g., cardiovascular compromise, COPD, diabetes) or pathogen type (e.g., Gram-positive bacteria, fungi); blank cells indicate absence.

Clinical complications and interventions: Values of 1 denote the presence of the indicated clinical condition or intervention (e.g., shock, organ failure, mechanical ventilation, acute kidney injury); 0 denotes absence.
Mortality outcomes: Coded as 1 for deceased and 0 for surviving patients, evaluated at 14, 28, and 90 days following enrollment.

Multi-omics profiling platforms: For each omics modality (scRNA-seq, TCR-seq, BCR-seq, CITE-seq, bulk RNA-seq, and Olink proteomics), a value of 1 indicates that the corresponding assay was performed on the sample; 0 indicates that the modality was not applied to that individual.
NA indicates data not available or not applicable.
